_note: Study 2 confirmatory protocol. Every value marked DECIDE is the author's decision; fill it in, write your reason in docs/PREREGISTRATION_v2.md, then commit BEFORE running src/study2_fetch_synergy.py. src/run_study2.py refuses to run while any DECIDE value remains.
model: identical to Study 1: TF-IDF(title+abstract, 1-2 grams, min_df 2) + standardised year [+ standardised log1p citations], LogisticRegression C=1 balanced liblinear
citation_groups: within each dataset: rate = citations / max(1, snapshot_year - year + 1); lower group = rate <= dataset median

bootstrap.unit: split_group_id clusters within dataset x fold (paired)

success_rule.primary: H1 supported if (blind - aware) lower-citation Recall@20% > 0 AND 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND gate passed
